citation: [2140 S. Prairie Ave. (Tucker / Smith house).] Photograph from the south-east corner of Prairie Avenue and 22nd Street, looking north-west across the crossing; unknown photographer, undated (after 1890). Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 2140 S. Prairie (file '2140prairie1880').
author: unknown photographer
date: undated (after 1890: the 1890 house at 2130 stands at right)
repository: chicagology.com (secondary reproduction; the original holder is not named). Prairie library image a20-chicagology-2140-photo-a (stream-2000-2100.json).
locator: The roadway of 22nd Street in the foreground, with street-railway rails and overhead trolley wires across the frame, and a cast-iron street lamp at right on the south-east corner.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only what stands in the street and where is read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-27 (T-3199) from the image store's reference copy (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a20-chicagology-2140-photo-a.jpg); the original host is not reachable from the build containers.
note: Strong evidence for 22nd Street as a streetcar street with overhead trolley wire after 1890; the lamp in the foreground stands on the south-east corner, outside the drawn district.
